sweep.in_sample_warning: The net-maximising threshold of 85 is chosen on the same 25,133 borrowers it is scored against. It is the best cutoff for this cohort's past, and an optimistic estimate for anyone it has not seen. Treat the shape of the curve as the finding, not the argmax.
sweep.what_the_best_threshold_means: The best net on this book is reached by approving nobody: at every threshold that lends at all, expected loss exceeds contracted revenue. That is a statement about the price, not about the cutoff - no threshold can fix a margin thinner than the loss rate. Re-price, then sweep again.
